name: prompt-612
image_purpose: Conceptual social post and surreal visual experiment

prompt.project_info: Create a surreal visual-recursion scene in which an approved adult man and an ornate picture frame repeat inward into an apparently endless loop.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult man with wide horrified eyes and a startled open-mouth expression, wearing a simple white shirt and dark trousers. He holds a large ornate picture frame and leans or tumbles forward into the image.
prompt.composition_elements: A large ornate dark-wood frame dominates the foreground. Inside it, repeat the same man holding the same frame with the same expression, nested into smaller frames spiraling toward the center. Maintain clear frame geometry, readable hands, and a strong central vanishing point.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody neutral studio light with soft controlled shadows on a grey vortex-like background, theatrical contrast, and an uncanny infinite-loop atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical social composition, high-detail photorealism, sharp frame ornamentation, consistent perspective, realistic hands and facial features, no accidental text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A surreal photorealistic vertical social image of one approved adult man with wide horrified eyes and a startled open-mouth expression, wearing a simple white shirt and dark trousers, holding a large ornate dark-wood picture frame while tumbling forward into the image. Inside the frame is the same man holding the same frame with the same expression, repeated into smaller and smaller frames spiraling toward a central vanishing point, creating an endless visual recursion loop. Grey vortex-like background, moody neutral studio light, theatrical contrast, intricate frame details, coherent perspective, realistic hands and face, uncanny darkly playful concept.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, gore, broken perspective, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate face outside the intended recursion, unreadable frame geometry, random text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

assets.name: prompt-612.jpg
assets.usage: Use for the recursive frame concept, subject expression, ornate frame styling, grey vortex background, and composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the recursive visual logic, approved adult subject, frame hierarchy, expression, and central vanishing point consistently. The reference is replaceable: another approved adult subject, frame style, or neutral background may be substituted while retaining the recursion concept. Explicitly define any replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
